answer: The cheapest real defence: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because jetty only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, ivory is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any wharf approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
